headline: ALMT Legal acts on Vishal Nirmiti ₹178 crore IPO
sum: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has raised ₹178 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares, comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating to ₹145 crore and an offer for sale by Promoter Selling Shareholder for ₹33 crore. ALMT…
detail: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has raised ₹178 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares, comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating to ₹145 crore and an offer for sale by Promoter Selling Shareholder for ₹33 crore. ALMT Legal, Bangalore advised and acted as the sole legal counsel for Vishal Nirmiti on this IPO. Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited acted as Book Running Lead Manager The transaction team was led by Rajat Bopaiah (Senior Partner), Souvik Paul Mazumdar (Senior Partner) and consisted of Natasha Ponnappa (Principal Associate), Associates Nikhil Krishna, Gunjan S. Jain, Danika A.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
